# Contributing to projectM Android Builds

Thank you for your interest in contributing! This repository uses a shim/publisher approach to package the projectM visualizer library for Android.

## Commit Message Format

This project follows the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) specification. 

## Development Workflow

Submit changes as pull requests with a clear description. PRs must be atomic, i.e., contain only changes which are strongly related. Open multiple PRs for unrelated changes.

## Project Structure

This is a shim repository that:
- Does NOT maintain a fork of projectM
- Only maintains packaging/publishing logic
- Uses upstream projectM build system directly

## Questions?

Open an issue for discussion before starting significant work.
